method: first-match-wins over commodities.json in array order: first commodity whose any include matches the name and none of whose excludes match claims it (the same oracle as explain-coverage-gap.ps1). Only names matching the proposed token can change under an include/exclude change, so those names are routed before and after; the rest of the corpus is provably unaffected by construction.

freshness: corpus frozen at about 10:25 on 2026-09-10 against comparison-2026-09-09 (built 08:06:45, pinned, not rebuilt during the review); the Family Fare sweep appends to family-fare-regular-2026-09-10.json every three hours and sams-deals-2026-09-10.json was rewritten at 09:21 by the browser-store task, so a re-run after a new capture will differ in corpus size, not in any of the routing changes listed
